title: Creamy Dairy-Free Mashed Potatoes
description: Don't think you have to give up mashed potatoes if you don't eat dairy; this dairy-free version is made with chicken stock and is as creamy as those with butter, milk, or cream.
ingredients: 0.5 cup low-sodium chicken stock, or more as needed
3 cloves garlic, smashed, or more to taste
freshly ground black pepper to taste
1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps.text: Cut each potato into quarters. Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until tender, 15 to 20 minutes. Drain and let dry.

Return potatoes to the same pot. Add chicken stock and garlic and mash potatoes with a potato masher. Add more stock if needed for desired consistency. Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with parsley.
